verdict.rationale: The Agent Toolkit says it gives agents pre-built functions to "access orders… shipment tracking, transaction details" (on npm as 1.11.0), so agent-side order and tracking lookups are a documented capability. However, the named tools shown are create_order, pay_order and create_shipment, with no explicit order-status or tracking read tool. The toolkit is also merchant-oriented, while the shopping-agent paths (Store Sync, the ACP and UCP protocols, the cart API) only cover cart and checkout state, and orders go to the merchant's own order system. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented get-order/get-tracking tool, a post-purchase status query in the buyer-agent checkout protocols, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
